column1:
A few showers are likely in the sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar to Pottuvil via
Kankasanthurai, Trincomalee and Batticaloa. Mainly fair weather will prevail over other sea
areas around the island.

Winds will be easterly to northeasterly. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to 40 kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Colombo via Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar to Colombo via Puttalam and from Matara
to Pottuvil will be moderate at times. The other sea areas around the island will be slight.
